description: Arcade racing with checkpoint-based lap tracking. Passing checkpoints increments progress; completing all checkpoints advances the lap.

behavioral_invariants.precondition: Lap counter is reset with CheckpointsPassed = 0.

behavioral_invariants.description: Passing all checkpoints resets progress and increments CurrentLap.
behavioral_invariants.precondition: Lap counter has TotalCheckpoints checkpoints and CheckpointsPassed = TotalCheckpoints - 1.
behavioral_invariants.expected_result: CurrentLap increases by 1 and CheckpointsPassed resets to 0.

behavioral_invariants.description: The lap counter starts at lap 1.
The vehicle's CurrentLap reflects its assigned lap counter.
